model.name: validated_candidate_pipeline
model.type: scikit-learn Pipeline: median SimpleImputer with missing-value indicators, then RandomForestClassifier (250 trees)

score.name: model_score
score.note: Random Forest vote fraction for class 1. It is uncalibrated and is not a probability.

evaluation.source: final_test_metrics.json, reproduced by the Phase 1 verification harness (checks V07 and V09)
evaluation.evaluation_caveat: This uses a new random split after earlier experiments; prior results influenced candidate selection, so it is not a pristine preregistered evaluation. Treat as a stronger follow-up, not external validation.
evaluation.data_caveat: Verify dataset provenance, label meaning, license, and consumption units. Features are customer-level summaries, not a previous-versus-current consumption comparison.
evaluation.interpretation_warning: FLAG is a dataset label, not proof of confirmed theft.

input_assumptions.window_status: inferred from the feature formulas; not confirmed

limitations: A positive prediction is a pattern similar to records labelled FLAG = 1. It is not proof of electricity theft.
Results come from one random split and are not external validation.
Precision and recall are modest; most flagged customers carry FLAG = 0 and most FLAG = 1 customers are not flagged at the default threshold.
The score is uncalibrated and is not a probability.
Dataset source, licence, FLAG meaning and consumption units are unconfirmed.
The seven raw-derived features are unverified against raw readings.
The model uses whole-period summaries and cannot compare previous and current consumption.
Decision Tree and SVM were not evaluated.
